SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 2777
Date 17 / 6 / 32

Memorandum on movements of N.F. Mihailoff, Soviet Employee.

Nicolai Filipovitch Mihailoff, reported to be an employee of the Cen-
trosojus, arrived in Shanghai from the USSR via Dairen on June 16,
1932, by the s.s. " Dairen Maru".
He is 39 years of age, an engineer by profession. Holds a Soviet pas-
port No 205027/ 20868 issued in Moscow on April 21, 1932.
Mr. Mihailoff is accompanied by his wife, Mrs Mihailoff, 37 years of
age, who holds a Soviet passport No 205028/20869 issued in Moscow on
the same date.
Efforts are being made to locate their address.

G. Prokofieff
D.S.
17/6/32.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
